extras: Uses a <palta-note> web component for rendering.
intentEvidence: Write Kaydas, Gats and Relas in Bhatkhande notation in Obsidian.
problem: Users lack a native way to render specialized musical notation like Bhatkhande notation for Tabla within Obsidian.
summary: Palta Note allows users to write and render Kaydas, Gats, and Relas using Bhatkhande notation within Obsidian notes.
